summary: Vertical Data Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 30, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of 1,413,640 common shares at $3.00 per share, approximately $4.2 million gross, closing November 2, 2026. B. Riley Securities acted as sole placement agent, receiving 22,916 shares as compensation. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and a potential national exchange uplisting, with a listing application targeted within 60 days and approval within 180 days of closing. Proceeds cannot repay insider debt, repurchase equity, or fund non-subsidiary investments. Watch uplisting execution and any resale registration overhang.
